header.name: Valuation and Portfolio Management
header.description: The goal of the course will be to help the students gain an appreciation of what is involved in: a) understanding what the investment opportunities are b) making good investment decisions and c) recognizing where investment problems and controversies arise and knowing how to deal with them

outcomes.label: CO1
outcomes.raw_text: Critically evaluate financial market information to measure risk and return

outcomes.label: CO2
outcomes.raw_text: Apply asset pricing models and valuation techniques to the valuation of the assets (fixed income, equities and derivatives)

outcomes.label: CO3
outcomes.raw_text: Demonstrate an understanding of the modern portfolio theory

outcomes.label: CO4
outcomes.raw_text: Measure portfolio risk and determine performance benchmarks and be able to take an applied perspective on investment management

weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: Analysis of a Mutual Fund Scheme

resources.title: Essentials of Investments; Bodie, Kane, Marcus (8th ed); McGraw Hill International
Investments: Principles and Concepts; Charles P. Jones (11th edition; Wiley)
Investments An Introduction; Mayo Herbert; (11th ed); Cengage Learning
Analysis of Investments and management of Portfolios; Reilly, Brown (10th ed); Cengage Learning
